newsitem.title: USA: PageNet to launch in Calif. in mid-April.
newsitem.headline: PageNet to launch in Calif. in mid-April.

text.p: Paging Network Inc said Wednesday it plans to launch its advanced voice paging product, VoiceNow, in northern California and Nevada on April 14.

The test markets include San Jose, Oakland, San Mateo, Modesto, Stockton and Sacramento in California and Reno and Tahoe in Nevada. PageNet said it is in the final stages of site implementation in San Francisco.
The company also said it plans to introduce VoiceNow in Los Angeles, Chicago, Miami and Atlanta by the end of May.
PageNet said it expects VoiceNow to be in more than 50 metropolitan markets nationwide by the end of the year.
The company said it plans to test various pricing and product packages in these new markets.
